target_customer: Brick and mortar restaurants and retailers wanting staff and customers to order and pay from their own phones
problem: Waiters and retail workers were tied to fixed or handheld POS terminals; customers wanted contactless order and pay.
business_model: payments take rate or SaaS POS (not stated)
product_category: Mobile POS and QR ordering payments

competitors.name: Square Online QR ordering
competitors.what: QR based self serve ordering for restaurants tied to Square POS
competitors.traction_then: available in US, UK, Canada and Australia on Square Online plans

technical_complexity.rationale: A POS plus payments integration with QR flows is standard engineering but needs payments compliance and restaurant integrations.

defensibility.rationale: Square and Toast shipped QR ordering in 2020 to 2021 inside their existing POS, making a standalone version easy to copy.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Square launched QR self serve ordering in September 2020 and Toast bundled mobile order and pay in 2021; Cheqout went out of business per PitchBook.

market_need_then: The pandemic from 2020 accelerated contactless ordering and QR menus; about 11 million US households scanned a QR code in 2020 per a Restaurant Dive citation of Statista.

branding.domain_note: Used cheqout.com per directory listings; no purchase history found.

brand_strength.rationale: Only directory listings and a dead CHEQOUT trademark record were found; the spelling confuses with Checkout.com and Cheq.

outcome_analysis: Cheqout built a QR and phone based mobile POS for small merchants and raised only the YC amount reported by databases. Square and Toast shipped near identical QR order and pay features in 2020 to 2021 inside their own POS, which is the probable pressure, but no founder post-mortem exists, so the exact cause is not public.
notes: Funding: PitchBook reports 125K accelerator round in January 2021 and Out of Business; CB Insights reports 130K seed Feb 2021 from Y Combinator (3 rounds claimed). The two likely describe the YC deal; recorded once, resting on databases. Website cheqout.com not fetched; no live page found by search. Failure factor incumbent_copied is an inference from competitor timing, not stated by the company.
